verdict.rationale: Lium's evidence shows the platform is built to be driven by the user's own external agents: an agent signup flow, a CLI and SDK, scoped budgeted API keys, and a docs and pricing MCP server. Nothing documents an AI assistant built into the product that users can delegate tasks to. Accommodating outside agents is an adjacent capability and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
